ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Desktop sidebar sticky NOT working. Sidebar has 'sticky top-0 h-screen' classes but computed position is 'relative'. When scrolling page, sidebar scrolls with content (top: 0 -> -176 after 300px scroll). This is a CSS flex container issue - sticky doesn't work properly in flex parent.

action_items: FIX SIDEBAR STICKY: The sidebar has correct classes (sticky top-0 h-screen) but doesn't work in flex container. Options: (1) Use position:fixed instead of sticky, (2) Change parent structure to allow sticky to work, (3) Make main content the scrolling container instead of body
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardLayout.js line 76-78: Parent div has 'min-h-screen flex' which creates a flex context. Sticky positioning in flex children can be problematic. The aside has 'sticky top-0 h-screen' but computed position shows 'relative'.
Potential fix: Change aside from 'sticky' to 'fixed' with left-0, or restructure so main content scrolls independently while sidebar stays fixed.
